description: Index of NAVIG Lenses — Tampermonkey-compatible .user.js files that change a website, in every NAVIG browser (NAVIG OS, navig cdp, the Chrome extension). Canonical form is the <id>/lens.user.js folder. Install: `navig install add lens:navig-run/registry/lenses/<id>`; any of them also installs in Tampermonkey or Violentmonkey from its raw link. Installed Lenses are checked for updates daily, and an update is held for review — never applied unseen.

lenses.name: YouTube without Shorts
lenses.description: Hides Shorts shelves, the Shorts tab and Shorts in search and subscriptions.

lenses.name: GitHub full width
lenses.description: Lets code, diffs and pull requests use the whole window instead of a fixed column.

lenses.name: Readable Hacker News
lenses.description: Larger text, a comfortable reading width and roomier comment threads on Hacker News.

lenses.name: Wikipedia reading width
lenses.description: Keeps article text at a comfortable line length with a little more line spacing.
